snippet.title: Mixtape - Exclusive Developer Interview - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
An exclusive interview with the developers of Mixtape, a narrative driven coming of age tale with an incredible soundtrack woven into gameplay, featuring artists like Joy Division, The Cure, Roxy Music and more.  On their last night together, three friends embark on one final adventure. Play through a mixtape of their memories, when Mixtape comes to PlayStation 5, PC, and Xbox Series X and S in 2025. 
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #mixtape 

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
